name: zoho-analytics-v2-mandatory-org-context
title: Zoho Analytics REST API v2 — mandatory organization context
description: Machine-readable mapping for the v2 move to mandatory organization context. Eight cross-organization endpoints replaced by three organization-scoped ones; two more now require the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header.
source_of_truth: The prose chapters in the parent directory. This file restates their tables as data; if the two disagree, the chapters win and this file is wrong.

deadline.meaning: The eight replaced endpoints stop answering. No extension, no opt-out, no silent fallback to the new endpoints.

header.name: ZANALYTICS-ORGID
header.value: The Organization ID, as a string of digits
header.applies_to: Every endpoint in the API, not only the ones listed here

org_id.note: GET /restapi/v2/orgs was the discovery call and has no replacement. The ID belongs in configuration, next to the client ID and refresh token.

behaviour_changes.summary: The dashboard listing is paged. Code that assumed one request returned everything must be rewritten, not re-pointed.
behaviour_changes.rule: Loop on pageDetails.hasNextPage. Never loop on len(views) < recordsPerPage — hasNextPage is computed after duplicates and role-restricted entries are removed, so a short page can still have pages behind it.

behaviour_changes.summary: getOrgDashboards returns an object containing views and pageDetails, where getDashboards/getOwnedDashboards returned an array.
behaviour_changes.rule: In Python, Ruby, PHP, Node.js and Go this is a runtime shape change, not a compile error. Add ["views"] everywhere the old return value was iterated directly.

behaviour_changes.summary: Omitting workspaceIds fails with 7476 when the caller can see more than 100 workspaces.
behaviour_changes.rule: Build batches of at most 100 workspace IDs from Get Org Workspaces for the same organization, and page within each batch.

behaviour_changes.summary: Access is checked at workspace level only, and names come from the stored history record.
behaviour_changes.rule: Tolerate an entry pointing at a view the caller can no longer open, and treat viewName/workspaceName as possibly stale.

behaviour_changes.summary: An Organization Admin or ordinary user whose primary email is unverified gets an empty list. The Account Admin does not.
behaviour_changes.rule: HTTP 200 with an empty array means nothing is visible to this caller. It is not an error.

sdk.shape_of_change: AnalyticsClient keeps only configuration and its four factories. Get an OrgAPI or WorkspaceAPI first, then call the method on that; the instance sends ZANALYTICS-ORGID automatically.

method_map.action: No replacement. Read the Organization ID from Settings → Organisation.
Drop the workspaceId argument — the WorkspaceAPI instance already holds it. The new config argument is optional (withUserRoleInfo).
Signature unchanged — only the object you call it on. It lives on OrgAPI, not ViewAPI, because the endpoint resolves a view from the organization alone.

error_codes.meaning: Workspace not found in this organization
error_codes.fix: Check the header before you check the ID — the workspace is probably in another organization.

error_codes.name: META_OBJECT_NOT_PRESENT
error_codes.meaning: View not found in this organization
error_codes.fix: Check the header before you check the ID.

error_codes.name: SECURITY_NOT_PERMITTED
error_codes.meaning: The caller is not an active user of that organization, or the request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain
error_codes.fix: Use an organization the user belongs to, or have an Account Admin add them.

error_codes.name: DBID_NOT_BELONGS_TO_ZSOID
error_codes.meaning: A workspaceIds entry is not in this organization, or does not exist
error_codes.fix: Take IDs from Get Org Workspaces for the same organization.

error_codes.name: ORG_LEVEL_VIEWS_NOT_ALLOWED
error_codes.meaning: Org-level view listing is switched off for the organization (reported to the Account Admin)
error_codes.fix: Use the workspace-level APIs, or contact support.

error_codes.name: ORG_LEVEL_VIEWS_NOT_ALLOWED_WL_USERS
error_codes.meaning: Org-level view listing is switched off (reported to every other caller)
error_codes.fix: Use the workspace-level APIs, or contact your account admin.

error_codes.name: ORG_LEVEL_VIEWS_WS_MORE_THAN_ALLOWED_LIMIT
error_codes.fix: Send workspaceIds in batches of at most 100.

error_codes.name: ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER
error_codes.fix: Send the header. A retry without it will never succeed.
error_codes.agent_message: This API needs an organization ID. Ask the user which organization to use.

error_codes.name: ORGID_NOT_EXIST
error_codes.fix: Re-read the ID from Settings → Organisation.

error_codes.name: MORE_THAN_MAX_LENGTH
error_codes.meaning: searchKey > 100 chars, workspaceIds > 10,000 chars, or CONFIG > 11,000 chars
error_codes.fix: Shorten, or send fewer IDs per call.

error_codes.name: UNABLE_TO_PARSE_DATA_TYPE
error_codes.meaning: pageNo or recordsPerPage is not a number
error_codes.fix: Send a plain number, not a string.

error_codes.name: JSON_PARSE_ERROR
error_codes.meaning: CONFIG is not valid JSON, or workspaceIds is not an array
error_codes.fix: Fix the JSON and URL-encode it.

error_codes.name: INVALID_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED
error_codes.meaning: A CONFIG value is null, empty or blank
error_codes.fix: Leave the key out instead of sending an empty value.

error_codes.name: EXTRA_KEY_FOUND_IN_JSON
error_codes.meaning: CONFIG holds a key other than the four documented ones

error_codes.name: ARRAY_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE
error_codes.fix: Send at most 1,000 — in practice no more than 100.

artifacts.name: OpenAPI 3.1 specifications
artifacts.read_by: Swagger UI, Redoc, client generators, MCP servers
artifacts.action: Re-pull whole. Do not patch — operations were removed and a merge leaves them behind. Regenerate every downstream client, validator, gateway definition, mock and contract test.

artifacts.name: OKF knowledge bundle
artifacts.read_by: AI assistants, RAG indexes, llms.txt consumers
artifacts.action: Re-ingest whole and DROP the vector index before rebuilding. An incremental re-index leaves the eight deleted documents retrievable. Confirm manifest.json reports version 2.0.0.

artifacts.name: Postman collection
artifacts.action: Import as a NEW version — Postman's merge keeps deleted requests. Re-import the environment, set organization-id by hand from the UI, delete or rename the old fork, and re-record CI assertions for pageDetails.

artifacts.name: SDK reference documentation
artifacts.action: Re-publish from source. analytics-client.md lost ten methods; org-api.md gained four; workspace-api.md gained one. Update your wrapper library's README too.

artifacts.name: MCP servers
artifacts.action: Remove tools backed by the eight removed endpoints, add three, make ZANALYTICS-ORGID a required input on every tool, decide org selection once (pinning is simpler and safer), handle pagination, and rewrite any description saying 'across all organizations'. Map 8083/8084 to an actionable message or agents will retry blindly.

artifacts.name: Internal wikis, runbooks, onboarding guides
artifacts.action: Search and fix by hand — nothing automates this. Onboarding guides are the worst offenders: 'step 1, call GET /restapi/v2/orgs' strands a new developer on their first morning.

artifacts.name: Deluge scripts and no-code automations
artifacts.location: Zoho Creator, Zoho Flow, CRM functions
artifacts.action: Two changes per script: the URL, and a headers line carrying ZANALYTICS-ORGID. No compiler will catch these.

artifacts.name: Monitoring and dashboards
artifacts.action: Add a log-based alert on the eight deprecated paths, tag it with the owning team, and watch it fall to zero. Done means zero for a full billing cycle, including month-end and quarter-end jobs.

gotchas.summary: Organization IDs such as 700000123456 exceed 32-bit range, and in JavaScript leave safe-integer territory once concatenated. Carry them as strings everywhere.
gotchas.symptom: 8084 that looks like a typo but is a silently truncated ID.

gotchas.summary: GET /restapi/v2/workspaces is removed; POST on the same path is Create Workspace and is unaffected.
gotchas.symptom: A path-only search and replace breaks workspace creation.

gotchas.summary: The methods are gone from all seven SDKs today, while the endpoints answer until March 2027. Upgrading the SDK breaks the build before anything breaks in production — deliberately.
gotchas.symptom: Compile errors immediately after an SDK bump.

gotchas.summary: CONFIG is stringified JSON then URL-encoded. Encode once, not twice.
gotchas.symptom: 8534 JSON_PARSE_ERROR on CONFIG that looks correct.
